subject: Post-call recap & evaluation roadmap — rerank model fit for Cartwise
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Heather Li <heather.li@cartwise.com>, Tom Nguyen <tom@cartwise.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 18 Jul 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap & evaluation roadmap — rerank model fit for Cartwise

Heather / Tom — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap + proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

Summary of needs (as discussed)
- Primary goal: improve product listing relevance for search and browse (top-10 ranking), reduce irrelevant clicks
- Metrics of interest: NDCG@10, MRR, CTR for top-3 results, and reduction in manual re-rank requests
- Data: you will share a 5k query sample + current click logs and ground truth labels for ~1k queries

Redwood next steps (owner / ETA)
1) Baseline evaluation: run our current open-model reranker (distil-bert-rerank-1) against your 1k labels to produce NDCG/MRR and per-query deltas — owner: Marissa — ETA: 48 hours (attachment: rerank_eval_summary_v1.csv)
2) Model recommendations: shortlist 2 variants for pilot — a stronger dense-reranker (electra-rank-large) and a quantized LLM-based reranker (gptx-rerank-q4) to compare latency/cost/accuracy — owner: Neha — ETA: 3 business days
3) Prompt set & evaluation harness: we'll share the exact prompt set used for LLM reranking and the evaluation notebook — owner: Marissa — ETA: 24 hours (attachment: prompt_set_cartwise_v1.txt)
4) A/B plan & rollout: propose an online A/B test for 4 weeks with 5% traffic for canary -> expand to 20% if no regression — owner: Karthik / Product Ops — ETA: draft by Wed 7/21

Risks discussed
- Quality regressions on tail queries — we propose an automated regression alert tied to your QA prompt set
- Latency impact for heavy queries — we'll include a cost/latency tradeoff sheet in the model recommendations

Ask from Cartwise
- Share the 5k query sample and schema + one-hot mapping for click signals by EOD Monday (7/20)
- Point legal to the mutual-action-plan PDF for procurement alignment

I attached the baseline CSV and the prompt set we plan to run. Tomorrow Marissa will post the first baseline numbers.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.com

---
Attachment stubs: rerank_eval_summary_v1.csv (summary + per-query NDCG/MRR), prompt_set_cartwise_v1.txt (10 canonical prompts + negative sampling instructions), mutual-action-plan-CW.pdf (MVP milestones and ownership)

From: Heather Li <heather.li@cartwise.com>

Date: Sun, 19 Jul 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & evaluation roadmap — rerank model fit for Cartwise

Thanks Karthik — this is perfect and matches our notes. A few clarifications/questions: 

1) The 1k labeled queries: those are primarily merch-driven queries and include holiday SKUs. We can deliver those by EOD Monday but they will be CSV with product_id mapping and click_timestamp. Is that OK?
2) For the A/B plan, can we start the canary on only 'search' traffic (not browse) since browse re-ranks are handled differently on our platform?
3) On data privacy: legal asked for a short doc that explains retention and whether any query text will be persisted in the hosted flow — can you send a brief note we can attach to procurement?

Appreciate the timeline. Tom (cc) will route the dataset to you Monday.

Heather
Head of Product, Cartwise
heather.li@cartwise.com

Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & evaluation roadmap — rerank model fit for Cartwise

Heather — thanks, yes, can do the search-only canary. A few technical notes and the concrete evaluation outputs you'll see in the first pass: 

What we'll run in baseline (today)
- distil-bert-rerank-1: estimated throughput 550 qps on our Dedicated tier; NDCG@10 baseline from your labels attached (see rerank_eval_summary_v1.csv)
- Per-query breakdown: we include NDCG, MRR, delta vs current production ranker, and a short "why it failed" tag when the model shifts position more than 3 slots

Model shortlist rationale
- electra-rank-large: cost/latency balanced solution; expected +3–6 NDCG points on head queries
- gptx-rerank-q4: stronger semantic understanding on long-tail, expected +5–9 NDCG but higher tail latency; quantized variant targets 40% lower cost than fp16

A/B test plan (brief)
- Metric buckets: overall NDCG@10 (primary), MRR (secondary), top-3 CTR (safety), 95p latency (SLO)
- Traffic: start 5% search-only (canary) for 7 days; if no regression move to 20% for 21 days; stop if any automated regression triggers (we define thresholds)
- Fallback: instant binary fallback to your production ranker on any SLO/regression breach

Deliverables by EOD today (internal)
- Full CSV with per-query metrics (rerank_eval_summary_v1.csv)
- Evaluation notebook + prompt set link (https://drive.redwood.com/Cartwise/rerank-eval-2026-07)

Legal / privacy note for procurement (short)
- We store query text and anonymized IDs for 30 days by default in hosted evals to reproduce results. Production Dedicated/Private deployments can set custom retention and can be configured to never persist full query text (KMS-integrated) — I'll attach a one-pager for Legal after they confirm exact procurement flow.

Action items for Cartwise
- Tom to upload 5k sample + 1k labeled CSV to the Drive link (Tom: please confirm when uploaded)

Marissa
Senior Applied ML Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
